name: studytocert-mobile
description: StudyToCert for iOS and Android: the study site bundled in a Capacitor app (see ../docs/MOBILE_APPS.md).

scripts.android: node build-www.js && cap sync android && cap open android
scripts.ios: node build-www.js && cap sync ios && cap open ios
scripts.assets: npm i --no-save sharp@0.34 && node make-icons.js && npx --yes @capacitor/assets@3.0.5 generate --iconBackgroundColor '#16202C' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#16202C' --splashBackgroundColor '#0E1319' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#0E1319'
